subject: english
question:
Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.

The family was watching Ramayana on the TV.

options.text: Ramayana was being watched by the family on the TV.
Ramayana has been watched by the family on the TV.
Ramayana was watching the family on the TV.
Ramayana is being watched by the family on the TV.

solution:
The correct answer is **"****Ramayana was being watched by the family on the TV"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The rule for converting this type of sentence:

 
 
• ​The construction of Active Voice here is – **Subject + was / were + Verb (+ing) + Object**

 The construction of Passive Voice here is – Subject1 + was / were + being + Verb3 + (by + agent)
 
 
 
• Here we can see that: 
 
 
• Subject(The family)+ was / were + (watching )Verb (+ing) + (Ramyana)Object.
 
• **Subject1(**Ramayana**) + was / were + being + (**was being watched**)Verb3 + (**The family**)(by + agent)**
 
 
 
• ​Hence, the correct answer is: *Ramayana was being watched by the family on the TV. *
